description: Header file defining the QuicFramer class and related interfaces for parsing and constructing QUIC protocol packets, including frame processing, encryption/decryption, and version negotiation.

classes.name: QuicFramerVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for callbacks during packet parsing, handling errors, frames, and protocol events.

classes.name: QuicFramer
classes.description: Main class for parsing and constructing QUIC packets, managing encryption, versioning, and frame processing.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes a UDP packet for parsing as a QUIC packet.

methods.name: BuildDataPacket
methods.description: Serializes a packet with given header and frames into a buffer.

methods.name: ParsePublicHeader
methods.description: Parses the unencrypted header fields from a packet.

methods.name: AppendPacketHeader
methods.description: Serializes the packet header into a writer.

methods.name: SetDecrypter
methods.description: Sets the primary decrypter for a given encryption level.

methods.name: SetEncrypter
methods.description: Sets the encrypter for a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetDecrypter
methods.description: Retrieves the decrypter for a specified encryption level.

methods.name: GetCiphertextSize
methods.description: Returns size of ciphertext for given plaintext size and encryption level.
